report_metadata.title: Phase 2 Final Deliverable Report — SHAKTI Operational Command Center Convergence

certification_summary.official_verdict_statement: Production Command Center runtime certification is blocked by the deployed frontend API routing architecture, while the Keshav backend itself is verified healthy.

blockers.impact: All /api/* requests return index.html SPA fallback instead of proxying to VM microservice ports.
blockers.remediation: Deploy Nginx or Caddy reverse-proxy container on VM to forward /api/* to backend ports (:8000, :5000, :5001, :5003, :8002, :8018, :8001, :3009, :8014, :8122).

known_non_blocking_conditions.status: HTTP 404 No ranking available (ML pipeline unseeded; safe UI fallback)
HTTP 401 Unauthorized without session token (Core stats endpoint is 200 OK with CORS)
